Hi Maya,

Thanks again for running the three-week pilot with us — all of us at Redwood really appreciated the close collaboration.

Attached is a concise results packet (redwood-pilot-results-brightcart-20270212.pdf) but the headline numbers I wanted to call out here:
- Average per-request latency for your checkout personalization model dropped from ~420ms on your current infra to ~130ms on Redwood (3.2x faster median).
- End-to-end token cost reduced by 48% when using our batching + KV cache profile at your 99th percentile sequence length.
- Sustained throughput: 175 requests/sec (p99 response within 220ms) on the Dedicated config we tested.
- Error rate (failed model invocations) fell from 0.9% to 0.1% during the pilot window.

These improvements translated to smoother UX during the traffic spike test last Wednesday — your analytics team saw cart conversion delta improve by +2.4ppt in the 1-hour spike window (we included event timestamps and dashboards in the PDF).

Would BrightCart be open to a short 20–30 minute call next week to record a 2–3 sentence reference quote and, optionally, a brief on-camera testimonial? We respect legal/comms limitations — even a one-paragraph quote we can use on the case study page would be hugely helpful for other teams evaluating inference economics.

Proposed times: Tue 02/16 09:00-11:00 PT or Thu 02/18 13:00-15:00 PT. If those don't work, share a slot that does and I will send a calendar invite.

If it's helpful, Ben (copied) can join to walk through the latency profile and the cache settings we applied.

Thanks again — really proud of the results we got together.

Best,
